transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted during transmission, safeguarding sensitive data. TRU-02 mandates secure PIN authentication, crucial for access control. TRU-03 requires logging transactions for auditability, while TRU-04 prevents negative balances, protecting users from financial mishaps. TRU-05 allows users to review their transaction history securely, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 ensures users are notified of insufficient funds, preventing unauthorized transactions. Finally, TRU-07 maintains data integrity, validating operations against business rules. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy ATM system.

transcript.statement: The ResponsibilityAgent emphasizes the need for ethical compliance and accountability in the ATM system. RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, safeguarding users and the institution. RES-02 mandates comprehensive transaction logs for transparency and accountability. RES-03 prevents negative balances, protecting users from financial harm. RES-04 reinforces secure PIN verification, ensuring user identity and fairness. RES-05 ensures funds are only withdrawn when sufficient, promoting responsible banking. RES-06 provides immediate notifications for insufficient funds, enhancing user awareness. RES-07 maintains user privacy through encryption, aligning with social responsibility. These requirements collectively foster a trustworthy and compliant ATM system.

transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-01 aims to minimize energy consumption, which is crucial for reducing operational costs and environmental impact. GRN-02 provides transparency by reporting the carbon footprint of each transaction, promoting awareness. GRN-03 ensures the use of energy-efficient hardware, reducing resource consumption. GRN-04 focuses on minimizing data storage requirements, which indirectly lowers energy use. GRN-05 offers clients electronic transaction records, reducing paper waste. GRN-06 promotes energy savings by shutting down during inactivity. GRN-07 ensures annual assessments of environmental impact, fostering continuous improvement. These requirements collectively enhance the sustainability of the ATM system.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the critical importance of safety and reliability in the ATM system. SAF-01 ensures no account can have a negative balance, protecting users from financial risks. SAF-02 mandates automatic fund withdrawal from savings if checking balances are insufficient, enhancing reliability. SAF-03 ensures users are informed and transactions are terminated if funds are inadequate, preventing unexpected financial issues. SAF-04 logs all transactions for accountability and traceability. SAF-05 implements secure PIN verification for user safety. SAF-06 allows limited withdrawals during maintenance, ensuring safe degradation. SAF-07 provides users with a clear summary of account status, enhancing transparency and trust.

transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the necessity of performance efficiency in the ATM system. EFF-01 ensures transactions are processed within 3 seconds, enhancing user responsiveness. EFF-02 mandates a throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute, crucial for high-demand environments. EFF-03 optimizes data retrieval to minimize latency, improving user experience. EFF-04 prevents negative balances, aligning with safety and efficiency. EFF-05 ensures automatic fund withdrawal without user delay, enhancing transaction speed. EFF-06 provides immediate feedback on insufficient funds, preventing wasted time. EFF-07 implements load balancing to manage requests effectively, ensuring system reliability under load. These requirements collectively enhance the ATM's performance efficiency.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance during transactions.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
